# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do NOT open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Please use GitHub's [Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/0xLizTech/stellarforge/security/advisories/new) on this repository. Submissions are reviewed privately by core maintainers.

If you are unable to use GitHub private vulnerability reporting, please email security disclosures to `security@stellarforge.org`.

### What to Include

1. **Description**: Clear description of the vulnerability and affected contracts or SDK modules.
2. **Reproduction Steps**: Proof-of-concept code, minimal steps to reproduce, or transaction payload.
3. **Impact Assessment**: Estimated severity and exploitability.
4. **Suggested Fix**: Optional suggested mitigation or patch.

### Response Timeline

| Stage | Target |
|---|---|
| Initial Acknowledgement | Within 48 hours |
| Severity Assessment | Within 5 business days |
| Fix Timeline Communicated | Within 7 business days |
| Critical Fix Deployed | Within 14 days of confirmation |

### Scope & Full Policy

For our full security policy, disclosure guidelines, audit reports, and resolved findings, see [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md).
